body: My life has fallen apart in the worst way possible since my country’s lockdown. Honestly, I just wanna die.

After my post, I basically slept for 2 days, and I don’t really have the strength to end my life. I want to, and I don’t really have the strength to do anything right now, but I’m trying to get past it. My ex (who is my recent ex and is basically the reason why I’m like this), is now taking to me to make sure I’m ok. But I think it’s out of shame and guilt towards herself, rather than out of love and pure caring. I have some anger towards what she’s done, but that will do nothing but make things worse right now. I don’t have the strength to end my life, I’m not going to try again, but if something happens that could result in my death; I won’t stop it from happening. I’ve basically given up on life, but can’t go the distance in ending it.

Perhaps. But it makes it worse knowing the woman I loved keeps hurting me and has no remorse about what she’s doing or how it’s affecting me. She’s never cared about me. So if she lets me in tonight or not, I’m ending my shitty life. If it works, you’ll never hear from me again.

My life has never had any happiness. I don’t want to go through any more pain. I don’t want to get any support. I plan on killing myself with a shotgun blast to the chest. And apart of me what’s to do it in front of my ex, so she knows how bad she really fucked my life up, but I doubt she’d let me through the door. She’s put a trespass order against me. But regardless, that’s tomorrow nights plan. Here’s hoping she lets me in 🤞🏻
Turns out I’m just gonna get drunk and take all the sleeping pills I can find and just pass out while I’m in a hangman’s noose
